task_title: Check and complete input data: schema, data type, filter
content:
Task: Check and complete input data: schema, data type, filter. Detail: - Review the raw input data stored in Dropbox for completeness and consistency.
- Validate and standardize data schema — ensuring uniform column names, data types, and formats across files.
- Filter out unnecessary or invalid data before ingestion to optimize downstream processing.
- Document the finalized data schema to serve as a reference for all subsequent pipeline steps.

Task: Set up dataset for Migration. Detail: - Create and configure datasets in BigQuery to store both raw and processed data.
- Define dataset structure and table partitioning strategy (e.g., by date or source file) for optimized query performance.
- Apply appropriate data governance settings such as dataset access controls policies.
- Ensure dataset naming and structure align with organizational data architecture standards.

task_title: Setup the authentication & authorization access to Dropbox folder
content:
Task: Setup the authentication & authorization access to Dropbox folder. Detail: - Configure secure token-based authentication between Google Cloud Run and Dropbox API.
- Store access credentials securely using Secret Manager.
- Grant least-privilege permissions to control access only to the specific Dropbox folder required.
- Test and validate secure connection and data retrieval from Dropbox using sample files.

task_title: Build & scheduled pipeline to ingest data from Dropbox data files into Cloud Storage
content:
Task: Build & scheduled pipeline to ingest data from Dropbox data files into Cloud Storage. Detail: - Develop a Cloud Run service that automatically scan new or updated files in Dropbox.
- Schedule this ingestion using Cloud Scheduler or event-based triggers for updates.
- Transfer raw files into Google Cloud Storage (GCS) while maintaining folder structure and metadata.
- Implement error handling, logging, and retry mechanisms to ensure reliability of the data ingestion process.
- Track data ingestion events and maintain logs for auditing and troubleshooting.

task_title: Build pipeline to automatically ingest & process data from GCS to BigQuery
content:
Task: Build pipeline to automatically ingest & process data from GCS to BigQuery. Detail: - Develop a Cloud Run trigger to process data from GCS into structured BigQuery tables.
- Perform necessary data transformations such as parsing, type casting, deduplication, and enrichment.
- Ensure the processed data aligns with the predefined schema and supports downstream analytics or modeling.

Task: Deploy & test on dev environment. Detail: - Deploy all components (Cloud Run, pipelines, scheduler, authentication setup).
- Conduct end-to-end testing using sample Dropbox data to verify successful ingestion and transformation.
- Validate schema mapping, data accuracy, and pipeline performance.

Task: Cleaning Data & Feature Engineering. Detail: - Collect, clean, and preprocess raw data from Dropbox
- Handle missing values, outliers, and inconsistent records to ensure data quality.
- Perform data normalization, encoding, and aggregation by relevant timeframes (daily, weekly, etc.).
- Engineer new features such as moving averages, lag features, seasonal indicators, and category-based metrics (e.g., by outlet, product, or time period).
- Split data into training, validation, and test sets for experimentation and evaluation.

task_title: Training model for Demand Forecasting with predicting by Day/Batch-Day
content:
Task: Training model for Demand Forecasting with predicting by Day/Batch-Day. Detail: - Select appropriate forecasting algorithms (e.g., Prophet, XGBoost, LSTM, or ARIMA) based on data characteristics.
- Train multiple candidate models to compare performance across different forecasting horizons (per day or per batch of days).
- Tune hyperparameters and optimize model performance using cross-validation.

Task: Evaluation & Prediction. Detail: - Evaluate model accuracy using standard metrics (e.g., RMSE, MAE, MAPE).
- Perform backtesting using historical data to simulate real-world performance.
- Analyze residual errors and model bias to identify improvement opportunities.
- Generate daily or batch forecasts and validate results with domain experts or business users.
- Prepare final prediction outputs in a structured format for downstream systems or dashboards.

task_title: Building MLOps for model training & prediction
content:
Task: Building MLOps for model training & prediction. Detail: - Develop a training pipeline using tools using Vertex AI Pipelines
- Automate model retraining and prediction workflows on a defined schedule (e.g., daily, weekly).
- Implement model versioning and artifact tracking  Vertex AI Model Registry, BigQuery).
- Set up monitoring for data drift, model drift, and prediction performance.
- Integrate logging, alerting, and governance mechanisms to ensure reliability and traceability.

Task: Deployment & Testing on Dev Environment. Detail: - Deploy the end-to-end pipeline in a development environment.
- Test model training, prediction scheduling, and output delivery end-to-end.
- Validate performance, accuracy, and stability under real data scenarios.
- Perform integration testing with existing data pipelines, data for dashboards.
